dvc_status.command: dvc status; dvc params diff --all HEAD~3 2>$null | Select-Object -First 12

npm_build.command: cd web; npm run build; cd ..

docker_up.command: docker compose up -d --build 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 12; docker compose ps

docker_images.command: docker images voltcast; docker compose config --services

api_health.command: curl.exe -s http://localhost:8000/api/health; ''; curl.exe -s http://localhost:8000/api/model-info | python -m json.tool

api_forecast.command: curl.exe -s 'http://localhost:8000/api/forecast?origin=2010-11-20T08:00&horizon=4' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d['forecast'], indent=2)); print('predicted_energy_kwh =', d['predicted_energy_kwh'])"

api_predict.command: curl.exe -s http://localhost:8000/api/sample-request -o req.json; (Get-Content req.json | ConvertFrom-Json).history.Count; curl.exe -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '@req.json' http://localhost:8000/api/predict | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('model:', d['model'], '| horizon:', d['horizon'], '| energy kWh:', d['predicted_energy_kwh']); [print(p['timestamp'], round(p['predicted_kw'],3), 'peak prob', round(p['peak_probability'],2), 'alert', p['peak_alert']) for p in d['forecast'][:8]]"; Remove-Item req.json

api_invalid.command: curl.exe -s -w '  -> HTTP %{http_code}' 'http://localhost:8000/api/forecast?origin=2010-10-01T08:00&horizon=99'; ''; curl.exe -s -w '  -> HTTP %{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"history\": [], \"horizon\": 5}' http://localhost:8000/api/predict

prometheus_query.command: curl.exe -s 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/targets' | python -c "import sys,json; [print('target', t['scrapeUrl'], 'health', t['health']) for t in json.load(sys.stdin)['data']['activeTargets']]"; curl.exe -s 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=sum(voltcast_predictions_total)' | python -m json.tool

grafana_api.command: curl.exe -s 'http://localhost:3000/api/search?query=VoltCast' | python -m json.tool; curl.exe -s http://localhost:3000/api/datasources | python -m json.tool

ci_run_view.command: gh run view (gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId')

vercel_ls.command: npx --yes vercel ls voltcast 2>&1 | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'hint|CategoryInfo|FullyQualified|At line|~~~|^\s*\+|^node.exe' } | Select-Object -First 16

live_site.command: curl.exe -s https://voltcast-forecast.vercel.app/api/health; ''; curl.exe -s -o NUL -w 'web app: HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes' https://voltcast-forecast.vercel.app/

k8s_validate.command: python -c "import yaml; docs=list(yaml.safe_load_all(open('k8s/deployment.yaml'))); [print(d['kind'], d['metadata']['name']) for d in docs]"; docker compose config -q; 'docker compose config: OK'
